The '''''Ajuur''-class heavy cruiser''' was a model of [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] that was used during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR:THoD" /> ''Ajuur''-class cruisers were a favored [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], and dozens of the cruisers were used during the Cartel's [[Annexation of neutral systems|annexation]] of neutral [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]. Thirty ''Ajuur''-class cruisers were used to blockade the [[Makeb system/Legends|Makeb system]] when the Cartel moved to [[Conquest of Makeb|conquer]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]].<ref name="TOR:TiP" />

The flagship of [[Mandalore the Vindicated]], the ''[[Spirit of Vengeance]]'', was a model of the class.<ref name="TOR:THoD" />
